title: What is lithium?
summary: Construction Advisor Marty reflects that while equipment may change at our West Angelas operation over time, the strength of the site has always been its people.
body_markdown:
## What is lithium and why is it important?


[Lithium](https://www.riotinto.com/en/products/lithium) is a naturally occurring element and the lightest metal. In its pure form, lithium is a soft, silvery-grey metal. It's **highly reactive** , chemically-bound to other elements in minerals and salts.


Its unique chemical properties make it irreplaceable in a wide range of applications, including everything from rechargeable batteries to glass, ceramics and other industrial products like lubricating greases.


Lithium is also **lightweight and energy-dense** . It can store large amounts of energy relative to its weight, making it an important material in rechargeable batteries where storing a lot of energy without adding too much weight matters.


The lithium used in everyday applications like rechargeable batteries doesn't come out of the ground ready to use. Instead, it needs to be extracted, processed and in some cases, concentrated, into the lithium product required for its end use. And although lithium is plentiful in the ground, significant investments in new mines and refineries are required for supply to meet demand in the future.
